caption: The drawing features a life-sized figure of a woman standing upright, depicted in Victorian-style attire. The woman is composed entirely of what appears to be corn husks or a similar natural fiber, rendered in shades of tan, light brown, and beige. Her dress is long, reaching the floor, with decorative scalloped edges at the hem and small dark dots or beads scattered throughout the skirt and bodice. She wears a fitted bodice with puffed sleeves and a wide capelet draped over her shoulders, matching the color and material of the dress. Around her waist is a thick belt with a large, oval buckle. On her left arm, she carries a closed umbrella or parasol, also brown and ribbed, matching the dress. Her hat is similarly constructed, wide-brimmed, with dark green and pinkish-red flower decorations on top. Her face is simple, with dot eyes and small markings for the nose and mouth, and her hair is covered by the hat and a scarf tied under her chin. The background is plain and beige.
title: Corn Husk Doll
